name: Flashlight
summary: Handheld torch in side view with a ribbed grip and optional light beam; for camping, night and torch-search scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the torch lies on the floor at y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 420 px long); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: beam
params.note: true = show a light beam from the lens

params.name: anim
params.note: pulse = the beam breathes in and out (needs beam true)

author: krakujs
